question: I know it is possible to set something like "tide ....  <team name>" @teams inform me shortly
answer: tide has no team command: `tide agents` has only list and restore. A session's team is declared with `tmux set-option -t <session> @miadi-team <id>`, or MIADI_TEAM=<id> when the agent is launched; otherwise the binding line finds it from teams/teams.json.
gap: William expected a tide command that sets a session's team. None exists.
